messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: embeddings-hot route QPS spike detected (>7000) and increased error 429s. Auto-mitigations triggered: stage-1 rate limit applied. Paging ivy_oncall and lee_sre.

ivy_oncall: on it. seeing a sharp jump from a handful of customers, origin: eu-west-1. errors are mostly 429 and a small amount of 504s. linking logs.

lee_sre: thx. can we do a rapid carve: move non-critical customers to standby route, reduce embeddings route qps per-customer, and deprioritize rerank? suggest per-endpoint caps: embeddings 40 qps/customer, chat 250 qps/customer, rerank 8 qps/customer as a temporary hold.

ana_pm: FYI this may impact a couple of paying customers on big-batch jobs (acct: buildlytics, synclytics). I'll notify support to prepare comms.

ivy_oncall: running quick check on route variants. command I'm about to run:
```
adminctl route update --route embeddings-hot --per_customer_qps 40 --deprioritize rerank
adminctl route set-weight --route embeddings-standby --weight +15%
```

incident-bot: Change request queued. Approval: auto (oncall). Executing now...

alex_infra: I can spin up an extra embeddings-standby pool in eu-west-1 -> +2 nodes, ETA ~4m if needed. Holding until we see immediate effect from carve.

lee_sre: executed the per-customer limit change and lowered global embeddings QPS throttle. Also pushed a temporary rule to block un-authenticated batch endpoints for 30m.

ivy_oncall: initial telemetry: 2m after change 429s down 65%, latency stable. However chat route saw slight bump in tail latency due to fallback traffic for some customers. Reverting rerank to deprioritized but keep rerank-cap at 8 qps/customer.

jamie_support: can we get a list of affected customers + expected ETA for full recovery? I need to open a support ticket and trigger outreach.

ivy_oncall: affected: buildlytics (high job), synclytics (high batch), plus 4 small customers. Recovery likely 10-15m assuming no further spikes. If we need permanent carve we'll schedule a follow-up.

ana_pm: please add this to incident doc. action items: 1) temporary per-endpoint caps (persist for 1h) 2) follow-up: better per-customer burst protection 3) product: review rerank default on heavy embed jobs

lee_sre: created short-lived dashboard and linked to incident. also added a safety rule: auto-fallback to embeddings-standby if embeddings-hot 5xx rate >1% for 3m.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Suggestions: run postmortem if >30m impact or customer-facing tickets opened.

ivy_oncall: handing off to lee_sre for extended monitoring and cleanup. I'll remain on standby for customer comms with jamie_support. :thumbsup:

lee_sre: acknowledged. I'll keep this thread updated and start a follow-up RFC for per-endpoint quota defaults and hard caps.

jamie_support: notified affected customers with expected degradation window. will update if any pushback.

ana_pm: thanks all. next steps assigned in Jira: IDS-314 (post-incident evaluation), ENGOPS-789 (quota defaults), CS-1024 (customer comms).
